# ToolsVibe
ToolsVibe is a free online tools platform offering Pakistan-specific tax calculators (salary, freelancer, Zakat, EMI) and general utilities (image tools, QR generator, JSON formatter, word counter, PDF tools).

## Main Pages
- Homepage: https://toolsvibe.online/
- All Tools: https://toolsvibe.online/tools/
- Blog: https://toolsvibe.online/blog/
- About: https://toolsvibe.online/about/

## Key Tools
- Salary Tax Calculator: https://toolsvibe.online/tools/salary-tax-calculator/
- Freelancer Tax Calculator: https://toolsvibe.online/tools/freelancer-tax-calculator/
- Zakat Calculator: https://toolsvibe.online/tools/zakat-calculator/
- Image Compressor: https://toolsvibe.online/tools/image-compressor/
- QR Code Generator: https://toolsvibe.online/tools/qr-generator/
- PDF Redaction: https://toolsvibe.online/tools/pdf-redaction/
